duplication_audit.novel_axis: fixed-bin state-dependent first through third conditional increment moments of each historical physical path
duplication_audit.distinction: v30 estimates cross-channel conditional-bin transfer entropy and directional information; v40 counts threshold passages; v41 maps paths through a fixed recurrent state. v42 estimates univariate local drift, diffusion, and third conditional increment moments given current amplitude, with no entropy, cross-channel direction, learned state, or prior prediction.
duplication_audit.cross_problem_note: P1 v18 was a different binary anomaly preflight that stopped at zero fits. No P1 support result, feature, prediction, bin, gate, or hyperparameter is transferred; P3 support is independently measured before fit.

encoder.input: historical hs, tp, hmax, and wind-speed paths at fixed 20-minute subsampling from the past-only 48h context
encoder.empty_bin_rule: occupancy and moments are exact zero

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Siegert, Friedrich, and Peinke, Analysis of data sets of stochastic systems, Physics Letters A 243, 275-280 (1998)
primary_sources.use: conditional-moment drift/diffusion mechanism only; not a Markov assumption or performance evidence
